60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals Received Notice of Delisting Less than 1 min read

SXTP On November 19, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that its bid price had been below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, violating Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), and determined to delist its securities. Because the company had completed reverse stock splits within the prior year, it is ineligible for a standard compliance period; it requested a hearing by the November 27, 2026 deadline, which stays the suspension and Form 25-NSE filing pending the Panel's decision. News / GuruFocus / Amazon Stocks Fall 3.87% as Its $188 Billion Anthropic Stake Starts Trading Daily

Amazon Stocks Fall 3.87% as Its $188 Billion Anthropic Stake Starts Trading Daily Less than 1 min read

AMZN ANT Amazon.com AMZN dropped 3.87% to $257.37 at the 4:00 p.m. ET close on November 19, the worst move among the Anthropic-linked mega-caps on the day of the AI lab's debut. Consumer discretionary was the weakest S&P 500 sector in a broad 2% selloff. Amazon is Anthropic's biggest shareholder. It holds about 1.94 billion non-voting shares, or 14.6%, after investing roughly $18 billion, Fortune reported from the final prospectus. The commercial tie is even larger. Anthropic has committed $110 billion to Amazon through April 2036, Forbes noted in its analysis, payable regardless of usage, or about $11 billion a year. Amazon already booked $62.9 billion of gains on private investments in the first nine months of 2026, mostly from Anthropic.

At Anthropic's $97.17 close, Amazon's stake is worth about $188 billion, roughly 6.8% of Amazon's $2.78 trillion market value on GuruFocus. That cuts both ways, because each $1 move in Anthropic's shares changes the stake by about $1.9 billion and can whipsaw reported net income. The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 93/100, signaling strong profitability and momentum with a balance sheet that is solid rather than spotless. GF Value is $259.88, so the shares trade about 1% below it, fairly valued. The bull case is already in the price. The next test is whether AWS growth in the fourth quarter shows the $110 billion commitment turning into recognized revenue.

Investors had looked to Anthropic's record $81.3 billion initial public offering and Nvidia's quarterly earnings beat under interim CEO Colette Kress to steady sentiment following Jensen Huang's resignation, CNBC reported. Instead, Anthropic's retreat toward its $83 offer price echoed Seaport Research warnings, covered by CNBC, that its valuation demands much faster revenue growth. Separately, Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook warned against delaying rate hikes ahead of an expected December increase. Compounding the concerns, President Donald Trump threatened penalties on overseas U.S. data-center builds as new Commerce Department export-licensing rules weighed on chipmakers. However, unadjusted final demand climbed 6.5% over the past twelve months, the fastest annual pace since November 2022, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield up nearly four basis points to 5.14%. Northlight Asset Management Chief Investment Officer Chris Zaccarelli told CNBC that persistent price pressures keep the Federal Reserve on course to raise interest rates in December. When benchmark bond yields sit above 5%, elevated equity valuations face immediate discount-rate pressure.
